checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: add a claim-bounded digit-symbol processing-speed focus test grounded in broad CCT and game-design evidence

impact_assessment.why: The practice lineup has simple reaction time and paired associates but no symbol-digit association speed task; broad CCT meta-analyses support processing-speed near transfer.
impact_assessment.benefits: A distinct, deterministic 13th focus test with accuracy, reaction-time and association metrics and an explicitly narrow claim.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new MechanicId across engine/UI/tests; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: adaptive levels and count assertions must move with the id
impact_assessment.mitigation: Follow the Visual Search integration pattern, add failing-first tests, run all suites, play it in Edge, then commit.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: extract Abd-Alrazaq 2023 serious-games meta-analysis as context and record its low-quality/supplementary conclusion in the game rationale

impact_assessment.why: The app's games need a literature note on the quality of serious-game evidence; this 11-RCT meta-analysis explicitly concludes games supplement rather than replace established interventions.
impact_assessment.benefits: Adds a verified clinical games record and tempers the game-related rationale with the review's own evidence-quality caveat.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one context record + prose note; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: counts and references must move together
impact_assessment.mitigation: Verify via PubMed efetch, update counts/references/prose and the game rationale, run all suites, commit.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: add a PubMed-linked evidence citation to the home far-check card

impact_assessment.risks: contract: small UI text change + test; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use an existing in-corpus PMID, add a failing-first test, run all suites and review the UI.
